<!-- source: packages/db/README.md -->

# @miujs/db

> D1-compatible SQL for MiuJS: one `Database` interface over Cloudflare D1 and local bun:sqlite, with migrations, introspection and optional Drizzle ORM.

`@miujs/db` adds `ctx.db`, a small D1-shaped interface (`prepare`/`bind`/`first`/`all`/`run`/`raw`, `batch`, `exec`). The same code runs on a Cloudflare D1 binding and, locally, on `bun:sqlite`. It applies SQL migrations once per database, reads schemas back with `introspect()`, and, through the `@miujs/db/drizzle` entry point, decorates `ctx.orm` with Drizzle. It targets SQLite/D1 only; for Postgres or MySQL use Drizzle directly.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/db miujs
bun add drizzle-orm   # optional, only for @miujs/db/drizzle
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet). `drizzle-orm` (`>=0.45.0 <1`) is an optional peer dependency used only by the `@miujs/db/drizzle` subpath; `@miujs/db` itself never imports it.

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { db } from "@miujs/db";

const migrations = [{ id: "001_notes", sql: "CREATE TABLE notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL);" }];

export const addNote = route.post("/notes", {
  body: t.object({ body: t.string() }),
  handler: async ({ body, db }) => {
    const r = await db.prepare("INSERT INTO notes (body) VALUES (?)").bind(body.body).run();
    return { id: r.meta.last_row_id };
  },
});

export const listNotes = route.get("/notes", {
  handler: async ({ db }) => {
    const { results } = await db.prepare("SELECT id, body FROM notes ORDER BY id").all<{ id: number; body: string }>();
    return { notes: results };
  },
});

const app = miu({ name: "notes", routes: [addNote, listNotes], plugins: [db({ migrations })] });
export default app;
```

With no `database`, `db()` uses `sqlite(":memory:")` on Bun and `d1("DB")` on Workers. Migrations run once per database before its first request.

## The Database interface

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { sqlite } from "@miujs/db";

const database = sqlite("./data/app.sqlite");
await database.exec("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT, done INTEGER)");

const insert = database.prepare("INSERT INTO notes (body, done) VALUES (?, ?)");
await database.batch([insert.bind("a", false), insert.bind("b", true)]);

const first = await database.prepare("SELECT body FROM notes WHERE id = ?").bind(1).first<string>("body");
const { results } = await database.prepare("SELECT body FROM notes ORDER BY id").all<{ body: string }>();
const rows = await database.prepare("SELECT id, body FROM notes").raw({ columnNames: true });
console.log(first, results, rows);
```

- `bind()` returns a new statement. Booleans become `1`/`0` like D1; `undefined` is rejected (`MIU_E_DB_BIND_UNDEFINED`), pass `null` instead.
- `first()` returns a row, `first(column)` one column, or `null`.
- `batch()` runs statements in one transaction.
- `exec()` runs a raw script; `splitSql()` splits it on `;`, keeping trigger bodies and quoted text intact.
- `sqlite(path)` opens the file on first use with `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`. Bun only.

## Migrations

`migrate(database, migrations)` applies migrations not yet recorded in `_miu_migrations`, in order, each in one transaction with its bookkeeping row, and returns the applied ids. `migrateOnce` does the same at most once per (database, list) in this isolate; the plugin uses it.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { loadMigrations, migrate, migrationsFromGlob, sqlite } from "@miujs/db";

const database = sqlite();
const fromDisk = await loadMigrations("./migrations"); // 0001_init.sql, 0002_users.sql, ...
const applied = await migrate(database, fromDisk);
console.log(applied);

const bundled = migrationsFromGlob({ "0001_init.sql": "CREATE TABLE t (x INTEGER);" });
await migrate(database, bundled);
```

- `loadMigrations(dir)` reads `NNNN_name.sql` files ordered by number; the id is the file name without `.sql`. Bun, Node and Deno only.
- `migrationsFromGlob(files)` takes `{ path: sqlText }` (or `{ default: sqlText }` modules), for Workers.
- A failed migration is rolled back; earlier ones stay applied. Never rename an applied migration.

## Introspection

`introspect(database)` returns a `SchemaDescription` (tables, columns, primary keys, indexes, foreign keys) on D1 or `sqlite()`, skipping internal tables. `generateDrizzleSchema(desc)` turns it into Drizzle `schema.ts` source, and `tableSql` / `createTableSql` / `createIndexSql` render DDL from a description.

## Drizzle

Import `@miujs/db/drizzle` (needs `drizzle-orm`). `db({ drizzle: { schema } })` decorates `ctx.orm`; `drizzleFor(database, options)` works outside requests; `drizzle(ctx)` returns `ctx.orm` or Drizzle over `ctx.db`.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { integer, sqliteTable, text } from "drizzle-orm/sqlite-core";
import { sqlite } from "@miujs/db";
import { drizzleFor } from "@miujs/db/drizzle";

const users = sqliteTable("users", {
  id: integer("id").primaryKey({ autoIncrement: true }),
  email: text("email").notNull().unique(),
  admin: integer("admin", { mode: "boolean" }).notNull().default(false),
});

const database = sqlite();
await database.exec("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, admin INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)");

const orm = drizzleFor(database, { schema: { users } });
await orm.insert(users).values({ email: "alice@x" });
const admins = await orm.select().from(users).where(eq(users.admin, true));
console.log(admins);
```

To type `ctx.orm`, register the schema once:

```ts
declare module "@miujs/db/drizzle" {
  interface DrizzleRegister { schema: typeof schema }
}
```

The subpath also exports `tableFromSchema(name, t.object(...), { primaryKey, indexes, references, casing })`, which builds a Drizzle table and its `CREATE TABLE` SQL from a MiuJS schema; `schemaFromTable(table, { mode })` for the reverse; and `describeTable` / `diffSchema(current, tables, { ignore })` to compute migration SQL against an introspected database.

## Options

`db(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | `Database \| DatabaseRef` | `d1("DB")` on Workers, `sqlite(":memory:")` elsewhere | The database, or a D1 binding name via `d1("NAME")`. |
| `migrations` | `Migration[]` | none | Applied once per database before its first request. |
| `drizzle` | `{ schema?, logger?, casing? }` | none | Also set `ctx.orm`. Needs `drizzle-orm`. |

`drizzleFor(database, options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | `Record<string, unknown>` | none | Tables and relations for `orm.query.<table>`. |
| `logger` | `boolean \| Logger` | none | Drizzle query logging. |
| `casing` | `"snake_case" \| "camelCase"` | none | Drizzle column name casing. |

`sqlite(path)`: `path` defaults to `":memory:"`.

## Errors

- [`MIU_E_DB_BINDING_MISSING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_binding_missing): no D1 binding with that name in `env`.
- [`MIU_E_DB_UNSUPPORTED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_unsupported): `sqlite()` off Bun, or `loadMigrations()` on Workers.
- [`MIU_E_DB_BIND_UNDEFINED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_bind_undefined): `undefined` passed to `bind()`.
- [`MIU_E_DB_MIGRATION_FAILED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_migration_failed): a migration's SQL failed and was rolled back.
- [`MIU_E_DB_MIGRATION_NAME`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_migration_name) / [`MIU_E_DB_MIGRATION_DUPLICATE`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_migration_duplicate): a `.sql` file without a number, or two sharing one.
- [`MIU_E_DB_MIGRATIONS_DIR`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_migrations_dir): the migrations directory cannot be read.
- [`MIU_E_DB_MIGRATION_INVALID`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_migration_invalid): a `migrationsFromGlob` value is not text.
- [`MIU_E_DB_DRIZZLE_MISSING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_drizzle_missing): `db({ drizzle })` could not load `drizzle-orm`.
- [`MIU_E_DB_MISSING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_missing): `drizzle(ctx)` with no `ctx.db`.
- [`MIU_E_DB_SCHEMA`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_db_schema): invalid `tableFromSchema` options.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

On Workers the default database is the D1 binding `DB`; `d1("NAME")` picks another, resolved from `ctx.env` per request. The plugin reports the binding to `miu deploy cloudflare`.

```toml
[[d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_name = "<name>"
database_id = "<id>"

# to bundle migrations as text for migrationsFromGlob
rules = [{ type = "Text", globs = ["**/*.sql"] }]
```

When bundling with `db({ drizzle })`, add `import "@miujs/db/drizzle";` to your entry so the bundler includes Drizzle. `sqlite()` is Bun only and `loadMigrations()` needs a filesystem (Bun, Node, Deno); on Workers use `d1()` and `migrationsFromGlob()`.

<!-- source: packages/cache/README.md -->

# @miujs/cache

> Key/value cache for MiuJS with TTLs, tag invalidation and `remember()`, backed by memory, Cloudflare KV or Redis.

`@miujs/cache` adds `ctx.cache` to every request. Values are JSON-serialized, reads return fresh copies, and `remember()` shares one computation between concurrent callers for the same key. With no options it uses an in-process LRU locally and the KV namespace bound as `CACHE` on Cloudflare Workers. Use it to cache expensive reads, API responses or computed data.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/cache miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { cache } from "@miujs/cache";

let hits = 0;

export const counter = route.get("/count/:id", {
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  handler: async ({ params, cache }) => {
    return cache.remember(`count:${params.id}`, 60, async () => ({ computed: ++hits }));
  },
});

const app = miu({ name: "cache-demo", routes: [counter], plugins: [cache()] });
export default app;
```

`cache()` with no options uses `memoryStore()` (1000 entries) locally, and `kvStore` over `env.CACHE` on Workers when that binding exists.

## The client

`ctx.cache` (and `createCache(store)`) is a `CacheClient`:

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `get<T>(key)` | Value or `undefined`. Corrupt entries read as a miss. |
| `set(key, value, { ttl?, tags? })` | `ttl` in seconds; omit to keep until evicted or deleted. |
| `delete(key)` | Removes one key. |
| `remember<T>(key, ttlSeconds, fn)` | Returns the cached value or runs `fn`, caches its result and returns it. Errors and `undefined` are not cached. |
| `invalidateTag(tag)` | Deletes every key that was `set` with this tag. |

Tag indexes are stored under keys starting with `TAG_PREFIX` (`"__miu:tag:"`); do not use that prefix for your own keys. An index drops keys that expired or were deleted once it has doubled in size, and when all of its keys have a TTL it expires a minute after the last one, so tags that are never invalidated do not pile up in Redis or KV.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { createCache, memoryStore } from "@miujs/cache";

const cache = createCache(memoryStore({ maxEntries: 500 }));

await cache.set("user:1", { name: "Mia" }, { ttl: 300, tags: ["users"] });
const user = await cache.get<{ name: string }>("user:1");
console.log(user?.name);

await cache.invalidateTag("users");
console.log(await cache.get("user:1")); // undefined
```

Use `createCache(store)` outside requests (jobs, scripts). Clients over the same store share in-flight `remember()` calls.

## Stores

### Memory

`memoryStore({ maxEntries, now })` is an in-process LRU with TTLs. Each process (and each Workers isolate) has its own copy, so it is not shared between servers.

### Cloudflare KV

`kvStore(binding)` takes a KV binding or its name. A name is resolved from `ctx.env` on each request, and a missing binding fails only the requests that use the cache (`MIU_E_CACHE_BINDING`).

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { cache, kvStore } from "@miujs/cache";

export default miu({ name: "kv-cache", plugins: [cache({ store: kvStore("MY_KV") })] });
```

Notes:

- TTLs under 60 seconds are raised to 60 (`KV_MIN_TTL`, KV's minimum).
- KV is eventually consistent (up to about 60 s across locations), so `delete` and `invalidateTag` may take that long to be seen everywhere, and tag indexes written from two locations at once can lose a key.

### Redis

`redisStore(client, { prefix })` stores entries in Redis and lets Redis expire them (`SET ... PX`). The client is any `RedisLike`:

- `bunRedis(url?, options?)` wraps Bun's built-in client. `url` defaults to `REDIS_URL`, then `VALKEY_URL`, then `redis://localhost:6379`. Bun only.
- `redisFromCommand(send)` adapts anything that can send a raw command (node-redis `sendCommand`, ioredis `call`, ...).

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { bunRedis, cache, redisStore } from "@miujs/cache";

const store = redisStore(bunRedis(), { prefix: "myapp:cache:" });

export default miu({ name: "redis-cache", plugins: [cache({ store })] });
```

With another client:

```ts
import { createClient } from "redis";
import { redisFromCommand, redisStore } from "@miujs/cache";

const client = createClient({ url: process.env.REDIS_URL });
await client.connect();
const store = redisStore(redisFromCommand((cmd, args) => client.sendCommand([cmd, ...args])));
```

`RedisLike` avoids MULTI and EVAL, so Valkey, Dragonfly, KeyDB and Upstash work. The same client also serves `redisQueue` from `@miujs/queue`.

### Custom stores

A `CacheStore` moves strings: `name`, `get(key)`, `set(key, value, { ttl })`, `delete(key)`, and optionally `size()`, `forEnv(env)` and `inspect()`.

## Options

`cache(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `store` | `CacheStore` | `memoryStore()`; on Workers `kvStore(env.CACHE)` when bound | Where entries live. |

`memoryStore(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxEntries` | `number` | `1000` | Entries kept before the least recently used is evicted. |
| `now` | `() => number` | `Date.now` | Clock in milliseconds, for tests. |

`redisStore(client, options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `prefix` | `string` | `"miu:cache:"` | Prepended to every key. `""` for none. |

`set(key, value, options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ttl` | `number` | none | Seconds until the entry expires. Must be positive. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | `[]` | Tags for `invalidateTag`. |

## Errors

- [`MIU_E_CACHE_CONFIG`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_config): invalid store options (e.g. `maxEntries`, Redis client, prefix).
- [`MIU_E_CACHE_KEY`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_key): a key or tag is not a non-empty string.
- [`MIU_E_CACHE_TTL`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_ttl): `ttl` is not a positive number of seconds.
- [`MIU_E_CACHE_VALUE`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_value): the value is not JSON-serializable (`undefined`, BigInt, cycles).
- [`MIU_E_CACHE_BINDING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_binding): the named KV binding is missing from `env`.
- [`MIU_E_CACHE_REDIS`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_redis): a Redis command failed.
- [`MIU_E_CACHE_REDIS_RUNTIME`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_cache_redis_runtime): `bunRedis()` called outside Bun.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

With no `store`, the plugin uses the KV namespace bound as `CACHE` (`DEFAULT_KV_BINDING`) and falls back to memory if it is absent. With `kvStore("NAME")`, the plugin reports the binding to `miu deploy cloudflare`.

```toml
[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "CACHE"
id = "<namespace-id>"
```

`memoryStore()` works on Workers but is per isolate. `bunRedis()` is Bun only; on Workers use `kvStore`, or `redisFromCommand` over an HTTP Redis client.

- Related: [@miujs/queue](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/queue/README.md), [@miujs/ratelimit](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/ratelimit/README.md), [@miujs/db](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/db/README.md)

<!-- source: packages/queue/README.md -->

# @miujs/queue

> Background jobs and cron schedules for MiuJS, with retries, backoff and dead letters, on memory, SQLite, Redis or Cloudflare Queues.

`@miujs/queue` adds `ctx.queue.dispatch(job, input, { delay })`. Jobs are declared with `defineJob`, take a `t` schema for input, and are retried with backoff when they throw. Cron schedules dispatch a job on a 5-field UTC expression. With no adapter it runs jobs in-process on Bun, Deno and Node, and uses Cloudflare Queues (binding `JOBS`) on Workers.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/queue miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { defineJob, queue } from "@miujs/queue";

export const sendEmail = defineJob("send-email", {
  input: t.object({ to: t.string() }),
  retries: 3,
  run: async ({ input, attempt, log }) => {
    log.info("sending", { to: input.to, attempt });
  },
});

export const signup = route.post("/signup", {
  body: t.object({ email: t.string() }),
  handler: async ({ body, queue }) => {
    const { id } = await queue.dispatch(sendEmail, { to: body.email });
    return { queued: id };
  },
});

const app = miu({ name: "queue-demo", routes: [signup], plugins: [queue({ jobs: [sendEmail] })] });
export default app;
```

`dispatch` validates the input against the job's schema and resolves once the message is accepted, not when it has run. Pass `{ delay: seconds }` to wait before the first attempt.

## Jobs

A job's `run` receives `{ input, attempt, maxAttempts, id, job, log, env, dispatch }`. `attempt` is 1 on the first try; `id` is stable across retries. `dispatch` enqueues another job.

- A thrown error retries the job after its `backoff` until `retries` are used up, then the message becomes a dead letter.
- `backoff: "exponential"` waits 5 s, 10 s, 20 s, ... up to 1 h; a number is a fixed delay in seconds.
- Invalid input and unknown jobs are never retried.

## Schedules

`schedule(cron, job, input?)` runs `job` whenever the expression matches. Expressions have 5 fields (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week), support `*`, numbers, `a-b`, `a,b` and `/n`, and are matched in UTC. Scheduled jobs are registered automatically.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, t } from "miujs";
import { defineJob, queue, schedule } from "@miujs/queue";

const report = defineJob("daily-report", {
  input: t.object({ day: t.string() }),
  backoff: 30,
  run: async ({ input, log }) => {
    log.info("report", { day: input.day });
  },
});

const jobs = queue({ schedules: [schedule("0 6 * * *", report, { day: "today" })] });

export default miu({ name: "cron-demo", plugins: [jobs] });
```

On Bun, Deno and Node the adapter fires schedules itself. On Workers they run from Cron Triggers.

## Adapters

### Memory (default off Workers)

`memoryQueue({ concurrency, clock, maxDeadLetters })` runs jobs in this process; they are lost if it exits. It keeps the newest `maxDeadLetters` (default 1000) dead letters in memory, and `drain()` resolves once nothing is queued, running or delayed. With `manualClock()`, `drain()` skips delays and backoff, which makes job tests fast. Its timers (schedules, delays, retry backoff) are unref'd, so they never keep the process alive on their own: a delayed job that has not run when the process exits is lost, like any in-process job. Use `sqliteQueue` or `redisQueue` when delayed jobs must survive.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { t } from "miujs";
import { defineJob, manualClock, memoryQueue, queue } from "@miujs/queue";

let failures = 0;
const flaky = defineJob("flaky", {
  input: t.object({}),
  retries: 1,
  run: () => {
    failures++;
    throw new Error("boom");
  },
});

const adapter = memoryQueue({ clock: manualClock() });
const q = queue({ jobs: [flaky], adapter });

await q.dispatch(flaky, {});
await adapter.drain();
console.log(failures, adapter.deadLetters.length); // 2 1
q.stop();
```

The plugin's own `dispatch(job, input, opts?, env?)` works outside requests (scripts, tests); `stop()` clears schedule and delay timers. `cancel(id)` (also `ctx.queue.cancel(id)`) removes a message that has not started, e.g. a delayed one, by the id `dispatch` returned; it resolves false when the message already ran or is running (memory, SQLite and Redis; Cloudflare Queues cannot cancel). `addSchedule(schedule(...))` and `removeSchedule(s)` change cron schedules at runtime: on Bun, Deno and Node the minute scheduler starts with the first schedule and stops with the last; on Workers a cron fires only if it is also a Cron Trigger in wrangler.toml.

### SQLite (Bun only)

`sqliteQueue(pathOrDatabase, options)` keeps jobs in a `bun:sqlite` file, so they survive restarts. Several processes on one machine can share the file. A job whose process dies is rerun after `visibilityTimeout`.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { Database } from "bun:sqlite";
import { t } from "miujs";
import { defineJob, queue, sqliteQueue } from "@miujs/queue";

const job = defineJob("resize", { input: t.object({ file: t.string() }), run: () => {} });
const adapter = sqliteQueue(new Database(":memory:"), { table: "jobs", concurrency: 2 });
const q = queue({ jobs: [job], adapter });

await q.dispatch(job, { file: "a.png" });
console.log(await adapter.stats()); // { pending, delayed, inflight, deadLetters }
adapter.close();
```

Pass a path (`sqliteQueue("./data/jobs.sqlite")`) to let the queue open and own the database. Dead letters and schedule locks use `<table>_dead` and `<table>_once`.

### Redis

`redisQueue(client, options)` shares one queue between servers. `bunRedis()` and `redisFromCommand()` from `@miujs/cache` provide the client.

```ts
import { bunRedis } from "@miujs/cache";
import { queue, redisQueue } from "@miujs/queue";

queue({ jobs, adapter: redisQueue(bunRedis(), { concurrency: 4 }) });
```

SQLite and Redis adapters are `DurableQueue`s: `drain()`, `stop()`, `close()`, `listDeadLetters()` and `stats()`. Jobs receive the process env, not the dispatching request's env. Their poll, schedule and lease-renewal timers are unref'd, so an idle app exits without calling `stop()`. After `stop()` a job that is still running finishes, but the worker claims nothing more; after `close()` the queue never reopens its database. Dead letters are kept in storage (`<table>_dead`, or the `dead` list in Redis) until you delete them, so prune them periodically if jobs fail often.

### Cloudflare Queues (default on Workers)

`cloudflareQueue({ binding, queue })` sends `{ id, job, input }` to the producer binding and runs the consumer through `app.on("queue")`. See [Cloudflare Workers](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/queue/README.md#cloudflare-workers).

## Options

`queue(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jobs` | `JobDef[]` | `[]` | Jobs this queue can run. |
| `schedules` | `Schedule[]` | `[]` | Cron schedules; their jobs are registered automatically. |
| `adapter` | `QueueAdapter` | `memoryQueue()`; `cloudflareQueue()` on Workers | Queue backend. |

`defineJob(name, config)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `Schema` | required | `t` schema for the input; `t.object({})` for none. |
| `retries` | `number` | `3` | Retries after the first failed attempt. |
| `backoff` | `"exponential" \| number` | `"exponential"` | Delay before each retry (seconds when a number). |
| `run` | `(ctx) => unknown` | required | The job body. |

`memoryQueue(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concurrency` | `number` | `1` | Jobs run at the same time. |
| `clock` | `Clock` | `realClock` | Time source; `manualClock()` in tests. |

`sqliteQueue` / `redisQueue` options:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `concurrency` | `number` | `1` | Jobs this process runs at the same time. |
| `visibilityTimeout` | `number` | `30` | Seconds a running job's lease lasts; renewed while it runs. |
| `pollInterval` | `number` | `1000` | Milliseconds between checks for due jobs. |
| `clock` | `Clock` | `realClock` | Time source. |
| `table` (SQLite) | `string` | `"miu_jobs"` | Table name. |
| `prefix` (Redis) | `string` | `"miu:queue:"` | Key prefix. |

`cloudflareQueue(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `binding` | `string` | `"JOBS"` | Producer binding name. |
| `queue` | `string` | all batches | Only consume batches from this queue name. |

## Errors

- [`MIU_E_VALIDATION`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_validation): job input does not match its schema.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_CONFIG`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_config): invalid job, adapter or option.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_CRON`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_cron): invalid cron expression.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_UNKNOWN_JOB`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_unknown_job): the job is not registered with this queue.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_JOB_DUPLICATE`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_job_duplicate): two jobs share a name.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_DELAY`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_delay): `delay` is negative or too long (12 h on Cloudflare).
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_BINDING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_binding): the Cloudflare Queue binding is missing.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_TIMEOUT`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_timeout): a job's lease ran out with no attempts left.
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_RUNTIME`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_runtime): adapter used on an unsupported runtime (e.g. SQLite off Bun).
- [`MIU_E_QUEUE_SQLITE`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_sqlite) / [`MIU_E_QUEUE_REDIS`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_queue_redis): a backend operation failed.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

On Workers the default adapter is `cloudflareQueue()` with producer and consumer binding `JOBS`. Successful messages are acked; failures call `retry({ delaySeconds })` with the job's backoff until its retries are used up. Set `max_retries` above your largest `retries` so Cloudflare does not give up first. Schedules run from Cron Triggers whose cron equals the schedule's.

```toml
[[queues.producers]]
binding = "JOBS"
queue = "<queue-name>"

[[queues.consumers]]
queue = "<queue-name>"
max_retries = 10

[triggers]
crons = ["0 6 * * *"]
```

`miu deploy cloudflare` reads the producer, consumer and crons from the plugin. `sqliteQueue` is Bun only and `memoryQueue` is per isolate; `redisQueue` needs a TCP Redis client, so use `cloudflareQueue` on Workers.

# @miujs/ratelimit

> Rules-based rate limiting for MiuJS with fixed, sliding and token-bucket algorithms, IETF RateLimit headers, and memory, KV, Durable Object, Cloudflare binding and Redis stores.

`@miujs/ratelimit` provides the `rateLimit()` plugin: each rule matches requests by route, path, method or tag, counts them per IP, user, API key or a function, and blocks with 429 `MIU_E_RATE_LIMITED` and `Retry-After` when the limit is reached. `limiter()` applies the same algorithms outside routes (WebSocket messages, jobs), and `asAuthLimiter()` lets `@miujs/auth` use any of these stores.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/ratelimit miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { rateLimit } from "@miujs/ratelimit";

const login = route.post("/auth/login", { name: "auth_login", handler: () => ({ ok: true }) });
const items = route.get("/api/items", { name: "items", handler: () => ({ items: [] }) });

const app = miu({
  name: "ratelimit-demo",
  routes: [login, items],
  plugins: [
    rateLimit({
      rules: [
        { name: "login", match: { route: "auth_login" }, limit: 10, window: "15m", by: "ip" },
        { name: "api", match: { path: "/api/*" }, limit: 100, window: "1m" },
      ],
    }),
  ],
});
export default app;
```

Responses carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` for the matching rule with the fewest requests left.

## Rules

- `match` takes `route` (route name), `path` (`/api/*` matches the path and everything below; `:param` and `*` match one segment), `method` and `tag`. Every given key must match; a list matches any of its entries. A rule without `match` applies to every request.
- `by` is `"ip"`, `"user"` (signed-in user, else IP), `"apiKey"` (`x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer`, hashed; else IP) or `(ctx) => string | null`. Returning `null` exempts the request.
- `window` is seconds or `"10s"`, `"1m"`, `"15m"`, `"1h"`, `"1d"`.
- Rules with `by: "user"` need `auth()` listed before `rateLimit()` in `plugins`; otherwise setup fails with `MIU_E_RATELIMIT_ORDER`.
- Behind a proxy, set `trustProxyHeader` (e.g. `"x-forwarded-for"`). The rightmost address is used. Never name a header clients can set directly.

### Algorithms

| Algorithm | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `"sliding"` (default) | Weighted sliding window over the current and previous window. |
| `"fixed"` | Counter reset at each window boundary. |
| `"token-bucket"` | Refills `limit` tokens per `window`; `burst` sets the capacity. |

## limiter() outside routes

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { limiter } from "@miujs/ratelimit";

const perPlayer = limiter({ limit: 20, window: "1s", algorithm: "token-bucket", burst: 40, name: "player" });

const result = await perPlayer.check("player:42");
if (!result.allowed) console.log(`retry in ${result.retryAfter}s`);

await perPlayer.reset("player:42");
```

`check(key, { env, cost })` returns the decision plus `retryAfter` (seconds, 0 when allowed) and `reset` (seconds until the window resets). On Workers pass `env` so binding-based stores can find their binding.

## Stores

| Store | Exact | Algorithms | Runtimes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `memoryStore({ maxKeys })` | per process | all | all (per isolate on Workers) |
| `redisStore(client, { prefix })` | yes | fixed, sliding | any with a Redis client |
| `kvStore(binding, { prefix })` | no (eventually consistent) | all | Workers |
| `durableObjectStore(binding)` | yes | all | Workers |
| `cloudflareBindingStore(binding, { limit, period })` | no (per location) | fixed, sliding; `cost` 1 | Workers |

A rule a store cannot enforce fails at startup with `MIU_E_RATELIMIT_UNSUPPORTED`.

`redisStore` accepts ioredis, Upstash, Bun's client (`incrby`, `pexpire`, `get`) or node-redis v4 (`incrBy`, `pExpire`, `get`); `del` is needed for `reset`.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { durableObjectStore, rateLimit } from "@miujs/ratelimit";

export { RateLimiterDurableObject } from "@miujs/ratelimit";

export default miu({
  name: "edge-limits",
  plugins: [
    rateLimit({
      store: durableObjectStore(),
      trustProxyHeader: "cf-connecting-ip",
      headers: "draft-8",
      rules: [{ match: { path: "/api/*", method: "POST" }, limit: 30, window: "1m", algorithm: "token-bucket", burst: 10 }],
    }),
  ],
});
```

### With @miujs/auth

```ts
auth({ rateLimit: { limiter: asAuthLimiter(durableObjectStore()) } });
```

`asAuthLimiter(store)` uses fixed windows, like auth's own limiter.

## Options

`rateLimit(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rules` | `RateLimitRule[]` | required | At least one rule. |
| `store` | `RateLimitStore` | `memoryStore()` | Where counters live. |
| `keyBy` | `By` | `"ip"` | Identity for rules without `by`. |
| `trustProxyHeader` | `string` | none (`ctx.ip`) | Proxy header holding the client IP; rightmost entry used. |
| `headers` | `"draft-6" \| "draft-8" \| false` | `"draft-6"` | `RateLimit-*` headers, or `RateLimit` + `RateLimit-Policy`, or none. |
| `onStoreError` | `"deny" \| "allow"` | `"deny"` | On store failure: 503, or log and allow. |
| `now` | `() => number` | `Date.now` | Clock, for tests. |

Rule fields:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | `rule_<n>` | Counter and policy name. Letters, digits, `_ . -`. |
| `match` | `{ route?, path?, method?, tag? }` | every request | Which requests the rule counts. |
| `limit` | `number` | required | Requests (or cost units) per window. |
| `window` | `number \| string` | required | Seconds, or `"1m"` style. |
| `algorithm` | `"fixed" \| "sliding" \| "token-bucket"` | `"sliding"` | Counting algorithm. |
| `burst` | `number` | `limit` | Token bucket capacity. |
| `cost` | `number` | `1` | Units each request costs. |
| `by` | `By` | plugin `keyBy` | Who the rule counts. |

`limiter(options)` takes `limit`, `window`, `algorithm` (default `"sliding"`), `burst`, `store` (default `memoryStore()`), `name` (default `"limiter"`, the key prefix) and `now`.

Store options: `memoryStore` `maxKeys` (default `100000`); `kvStore` and `redisStore` `prefix` (default `"ratelimit:"`); `durableObjectStore` binding (default `"RATE_LIMITER"`); `cloudflareBindingStore` `limit`, `period` (10 or 60) and optional `namespaceId`.

## Errors

- [`MIU_E_RATE_LIMITED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_rate_limited): 429, the request exceeded a rule; see `Retry-After`.
- [`MIU_E_RATELIMIT_CONFIG`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_ratelimit_config): invalid rule, window, algorithm or option.
- [`MIU_E_RATELIMIT_UNSUPPORTED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_ratelimit_unsupported): the store cannot enforce a rule, or cannot reset keys.
- [`MIU_E_RATELIMIT_ORDER`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_ratelimit_order): a `by: "user"` rule but `auth()` is listed after `rateLimit()`.
- [`MIU_E_RATELIMIT_BINDING`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_ratelimit_binding): KV, Durable Object or rate limiting binding missing.
- [`MIU_E_RATELIMIT_STORE`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_ratelimit_store): 503, the store failed and `onStoreError` is `"deny"`.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

`memoryStore()` counts per isolate on Workers (the plugin logs a warning outside dev). Use one of the Workers stores; each reports its binding to `miu deploy cloudflare`.

`durableObjectStore()` (exact) needs the class exported from your Worker entry, as in the example above, and a binding:

```toml
[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "RATE_LIMITER"
class_name = "RateLimiterDurableObject"
```

`kvStore("RL_KV")` needs a KV namespace (`[[kv_namespaces]] binding = "RL_KV"`). It is approximate and allows about one write per second per key.

`cloudflareBindingStore("RL", { limit: 100, period: 60 })` uses Cloudflare's Rate Limiting binding. Every rule using it must have the same `limit` and `window`:

```toml
[[ratelimits]]
name = "RL"
namespace_id = "1001"
simple = { limit = 100, period = 60 }
```

`redisStore` works wherever your Redis client does (e.g. Upstash over HTTP on Workers).

# @miujs/realtime

> Server-authoritative realtime rooms over WebSockets for MiuJS, with state patches, timers, join codes, shards, Durable Objects and a client SDK.

`@miujs/realtime` runs multiplayer rooms (games, quizzes, chat, live dashboards) where the server owns the state. You define a room type with a state schema, typed client messages and handlers; every state change is sent to clients as a JSON patch. Rooms live in memory on Bun, Deno and Node, and one Durable Object per room on Cloudflare Workers. Use it when clients must not be trusted with the game logic or hidden state.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/realtime miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { defineRoom, rooms, t } from "@miujs/realtime";

export const chat = defineRoom("chat", {
  state: t.object({ lines: t.array(t.string()) }),
  client: { say: t.object({ text: t.string() }) },
  init: () => ({ lines: [] }),
  on: {
    say: ({ room, sender, msg }) => {
      room.state.lines = [...room.state.lines, `${sender.name}: ${msg.text}`];
    },
  },
});

// WebSocket endpoint: ws://localhost:3000/rooms/chat/<id>?name=Ann
const app = miu({ name: "chat", plugins: [rooms({ rooms: [chat] })], mcp: true });
export default app;
```

The first non-spectator to join a room becomes the host. Handlers mutate `room.state`; after each handler the new state is checked against the `state` schema (bad changes roll back) and a patch goes to every client. With `mcp: true`, agents get the `rooms_list` and `room_state` tools.

## Rooms

A room definition can also hold server-only state, per-player views, join/leave hooks and named timers.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { defineRoom, t } from "@miujs/realtime";

export const guess = defineRoom("guess", {
  state: t.object({ phase: t.enum(["open", "closed"]), winner: t.nullable(t.string()) }),
  secret: () => ({ number: Math.floor(Math.random() * 100) }), // never sent to clients
  client: { guess: t.object({ n: t.integer({ min: 0, max: 99 }) }) },
  init: () => ({ phase: "open" as const, winner: null }),
  timers: {
    close: ({ room }) => {
      room.state.phase = "closed";
    },
  },
  onJoin: ({ room, player }) => {
    if (player.role === "host") room.schedule("close", 60_000);
  },
  on: {
    guess: ({ room, sender, msg }) => {
      if (room.state.phase !== "open") return;
      if (msg.n === room.secret.number) {
        room.state.winner = sender.name;
        room.state.phase = "closed";
        room.broadcast("won", { name: sender.name });
      } else {
        room.send(sender.id, "hint", { higher: msg.n < room.secret.number });
      }
    },
  },
  maxPlayers: 20,
});
```

The `room` handle offers `state`, `secret`, `players`, `player(id)`, `broadcast(event, data, { except, to })`, `send(playerId, event, data)`, `schedule(name, delayMs, data)` / `cancel(timerId)`, `after(ms, fn)`, `tick(hz, fn)`, `now()`, `storage` and `close(reason)`. Named timers (`schedule`) are persisted and survive Durable Object hibernation; `after` and `tick` are closures and only work in local rooms. A `view(state, player)` function sends each player their own view of the state (hidden hands, fog of war).

## Client SDK

`@miujs/realtime/client` works anywhere with a `WebSocket` (browsers, Bun, Deno, Node 22+). It applies patches, reconnects with a resume token and queues messages while reconnecting.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { connect } from "@miujs/realtime/client";

const room = connect<{ lines: string[] }>("ws://localhost:3000/rooms/chat/lobby", { name: "Ann" });
await room.ready;
console.log(room.me?.role, room.state?.lines);
room.on("state", (state: { lines: string[] }) => console.log(state.lines));
room.send("say", { text: "hi" });
```

Built-in events: `state`, `welcome`, `error`, `open`, `close`, `reconnecting`, `reconnected`; other names are server `broadcast`/`send` events. Framework bindings are in subpath exports and take your framework as an argument (no dependency):

```ts
import * as React from "react";
import { createUseRoom } from "@miujs/realtime/react";

export const useRoom = createUseRoom(React);
// const { state, me, status, error, send } = useRoom(url, { name: "Ann" });
```

- `@miujs/realtime/vue`: `useRoom(url, { name, shallowRef, onScopeDispose })` returns refs.
- `@miujs/realtime/svelte`: `roomStore(url, { name })` is a readable store (`$room.state`).
- `@miujs/realtime/msgpack`: `encode` / `decode`; pass `encoding: "msgpack"` to `connect` for binary frames.
- `@miujs/realtime/loadtest`: `loadtest({ url, players, durationMs, actions })` reports latency percentiles.

Other languages (Unity, Godot, Swift) can join using the [wire protocol](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/PROTOCOL.md).

## Join codes

`rooms()` returns a plugin with `createRoom(type, { data })`, which creates a room and a 6-digit code. Pass `{ code: false }` for rooms reached by id only, such as matchmaker rooms. The plugin's route prefix is available as `realtime.path`. Clients resolve the code with `GET /rooms/code/:code` and then connect to the room id.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { defineRoom, rooms, t } from "@miujs/realtime";

const lobby = defineRoom("lobby", {
  state: t.object({ title: t.string() }),
  init: (ctx) => ({ title: (ctx.data as { title?: string } | undefined)?.title ?? "Lobby" }),
});

const realtime = rooms({ rooms: [lobby], codes: "ROOM_CODES" }); // KV binding on Workers

export const createGame = route.post("/api/games", {
  summary: "Create a lobby and its join code",
  handler: async () => {
    const { id, code } = await realtime.createRoom("lobby", { data: { title: "Friday quiz" } });
    return { id, code, join: `/rooms/lobby/${id}` };
  },
});

export default miu({ name: "games", routes: [createGame], plugins: [realtime] });
```

Code lookups are rate limited per IP. Without the `codes` KV binding, codes live in memory (per isolate on Workers).

## Shards

`shardedRoom` splits one logical room into shards of at most `shardSize` players, with a coordinator that aggregates across shards (for example a global leaderboard).

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { defineRoom, rooms, shardedRoom, t } from "@miujs/realtime";

const battle = defineRoom("battle", {
  state: t.object({ scores: t.record(t.number()), top: t.array(t.number()) }),
  client: { score: t.object({ n: t.number() }) },
  init: () => ({ scores: {}, top: [] }),
  on: {
    score: ({ room, sender, msg }) => {
      room.state.scores[sender.id] = (room.state.scores[sender.id] ?? 0) + msg.n;
    },
  },
});

export const arena = shardedRoom(battle, {
  shardSize: 100,
  aggregate: (shards) => shards.flatMap((s) => Object.values(s.state.scores)).sort((a, b) => b - a).slice(0, 10),
  publish: ({ room, aggregate }) => {
    room.state.top = aggregate;
  },
});

export const realtime = rooms({ rooms: [arena] }); // /rooms/battle/finals → shards finals:shard0, ...
```

## Durable Objects

On Cloudflare each room is a Durable Object named `type:id`. Export the class built from the same room types you pass to `rooms()`:

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu } from "miujs";
import { createRoomDurableObject, defineRoom, rooms, t } from "@miujs/realtime";

const chat = defineRoom("chat", {
  state: t.object({ lines: t.array(t.string()) }),
  init: () => ({ lines: [] }),
});

export const MiuRooms = createRoomDurableObject([chat]); // bound as MIU_ROOMS
export default miu({ name: "chat", plugins: [rooms({ rooms: [chat] })] });
```

The object uses the WebSocket hibernation API. State, players, resume tokens and named timers are persisted to Durable Object storage, and an alarm wakes the object for the next timer.

## Options

`rooms(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rooms` | `RoomType[]` | required | Room types served by this plugin. |
| `path` | `string` | `"/rooms"` | Route prefix: `GET {path}/:type/:id` and `GET {path}/code/:code`. |
| `binding` | `string` | `"MIU_ROOMS"` | Durable Object namespace binding on Cloudflare. |
| `className` | `string` | `"MiuRooms"` | Exported Durable Object class name (for `miu deploy cloudflare`). |
| `codes` | `string` | none (memory) | KV binding for join codes on Cloudflare. |
| `codeTtlMs` | `number` | `21600000` (6 h) | How long a join code stays valid. |
| `codeLookups` | `{ perMinute?, burst? }` | `{ perMinute: 30, burst: 10 }` | Per-IP limit on code lookups. |
| `emptyMs` | `number` | `30000` | Dispose local rooms after they stay empty this long. |
| `clock` | `Clock` | `systemClock` | Time source (`FakeClock` in tests). |

`defineRoom(type, definition)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `Schema` | required | State every client sees; checked after each handler. |
| `init` | `(ctx) => state` | required | Initial state; `ctx.data` is the `createRoom` data. |
| `client` | `Record<string, Schema>` | none | Messages clients may send, validated before handlers run. |
| `on` | handlers by message type | none | `({ room, sender, msg, now })` per client message. |
| `secret` | `(ctx) => X` | none | Server-only state. |
| `onJoin` / `onLeave` | `({ room, player, now })` | none | Join and leave hooks. |
| `view` | `(state, player) => unknown` | none | Per-player view of the state. |
| `timers` | `Record<string, fn>` | none | Named handlers for `room.schedule()`. |
| `rateLimit` | `{ perSecond?, burst?, kickAfterMs? } \| false` | `30/s`, burst `60`, kick after `3000` ms | Inbound frame limit per connection. |
| `maxMessageBytes` | `number` | `16384` | Largest inbound frame; bigger frames close the socket (1009). |
| `maxPlayers` | `number` | unlimited | Max non-spectator players. |
| `reconnectMs` | `number` | `30000` | How long a disconnected player keeps their seat. |

The `room` handle also has `room.kick(playerId, code?)` and `room.env`.

- `room.kick` removes the seat at once: no reconnect grace, resume token revoked, `onLeave` runs. The socket closes with `code`, default `4009`, which clients treat as terminal.
- `room.env` is the Durable Object's `env` on Workers (D1 and other bindings) and the process env locally.

`connect(url, options)` from `@miujs/realtime/client`: `name`, `role` (default `"player"`), `hostKey`, `resume`, `reconnect` (default on: `minDelayMs` 250, `maxDelayMs` 5000, `maxAttempts` Infinity; `false` turns it off), `encoding` (`"json"` or `"msgpack"`, default `"json"`), `WebSocket` (default: the global one).

`shardedRoom(room, options)`: `shardSize` (required), `maxShards` (default `64`), `aggregate(shards)`, `publish({ room, aggregate })`. `createRoomDurableObject(types, options)`: `binding` (default `"MIU_ROOMS"`), `clock`.

## Errors

- `MIU_E_ROOM_TYPE_INVALID`: `defineRoom` got a type name that is not 1-64 letters, digits, `_` or `-`.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_HANDLER_UNKNOWN`: `on.<name>` has no matching `client.<name>` schema.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_TYPE_UNKNOWN`: the URL names a room type that is not registered (404).
- `MIU_E_ROOM_ID_INVALID`: the room id is not 1-64 letters, digits, `_` or `-` (400).
- `MIU_E_ROOM_MESSAGE_INVALID`: a client message failed its schema.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_STATE_INVALID`: a handler left the state invalid; the change was rolled back.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_FULL`: the room (or every shard) has `maxPlayers` seated.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_RATE_LIMITED`: a client sent frames over the rate limit.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_CODE_UNKNOWN` / `MIU_E_ROOM_CODE_RATE_LIMITED`: join code not found, or too many lookups.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_TIMER_NOT_DURABLE`: `after()` or `tick()` was used in a Durable Object; use `schedule()`.
- `MIU_E_ROOM_SHARD_SIZE`: `shardedRoom` got a bad `shardSize`.
- `MIU_E_WS_EXPECTED`: plain HTTP request to the WebSocket URL (426).

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md), e.g. [`MIU_E_ROOM_FULL`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_room_full).

## Cloudflare Workers

- **Durable Objects:** one object per room, binding `MIU_ROOMS` (option `binding`), class `MiuRooms` (option `className`). Export `createRoomDurableObject([...])` under that class name.
- **KV:** optional, for join codes (option `codes`). Without it, codes are per isolate.
- Without the Durable Object binding on Workers, rooms fall back to in-isolate memory and log a warning; they are not shared across isolates.

`miu deploy cloudflare` writes these bindings from the plugin. The shape:

```toml
[[kv_namespaces]]
binding = "ROOM_CODES"

[[durable_objects.bindings]]
name = "MIU_ROOMS"
class_name = "MiuRooms"

[[migrations]]
tag = "v1"
new_sqlite_classes = ["MiuRooms"]
```

On Bun, Deno and Node rooms run in process (`LocalRooms`); nothing else is needed.

- [Getting started guide](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/guide.md)
- [Error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md)
- [Wire protocol](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/PROTOCOL.md)
- [Quiz example](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/examples/quiz)
- [Source](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/src)
- [Tests](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/realtime/test)

# @miujs/files

> File storage for MiuJS: `ctx.files` with memory, local disk, Cloudflare R2 and S3 stores, signed URLs, checked uploads and resumable multipart uploads.

`@miujs/files` adds `ctx.files` to every request: put, get, head, delete and list files by key, sign short-lived download or upload URLs, and accept uploads whose real type is checked from their bytes. The store is swappable: memory in development, a local directory on a server, R2 or any S3-compatible service in production. Use it for avatars, attachments, exports and large assets such as 3D models.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/files miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { files } from "@miujs/files";

export const saveNote = route.put("/notes/:id", {
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  body: t.object({ text: t.string() }),
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    const stored = await ctx.files.put(`notes/${ctx.params.id}.txt`, ctx.body.text, { contentType: "text/plain" });
    return { key: stored.key, size: stored.size };
  },
});

export const noteLink = route.get("/notes/:id/link", {
  params: t.object({ id: t.string() }),
  handler: async (ctx) => ({ url: await ctx.files.signedUrl(`notes/${ctx.params.id}.txt`, { expiresIn: 300 }) }),
});

// Development: memoryStore() and a random signing secret. Set FILES_SECRET before deploying.
export default miu({ name: "notes", routes: [saveNote, noteLink], plugins: [files()] });
```

`ctx.files` methods:

- `put(key, body, { contentType, metadata })`: store bytes (string, bytes, `Blob` or stream). Returns the stored file info.
- `get(key, { range })`: the file and a stream of its bytes, or `null`.
- `head(key)`, `delete(key)`, `list({ prefix, cursor, limit })`.
- `signedUrl(key, options)`: a URL to the plugin's own route, see below.
- `handleUpload(ctx, options)`: store the files from this request after checking them.

Keys are relative, `/`-separated paths such as `avatars/u1.png`: no leading `/`, no `.` or `..` segments, no backslashes or `:` (max 1024 bytes). `checkKey(key)` validates one.

## Stores

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { files, localStore, memoryStore, r2Store, s3Store } from "@miujs/files";

export const dev = files({ store: memoryStore() });              // default in development
export const disk = files({ store: localStore("./data/files") }); // Bun and Node
export const r2 = files({ store: r2Store("FILES") });            // Cloudflare R2 binding, read per request
export const minio = files({
  store: s3Store({ endpoint: "http://localhost:9000", bucket: "uploads", forcePathStyle: true }),
});
```

- `memoryStore()`: in-process, lost on restart. The plugin refuses to start without a `store` in production (`MIU_E_FILES_STORE_MISSING`).
- `localStore(dir)`: files under `dir`, written to `tmp/` and renamed into place. Bun and Node only.
- `r2Store(binding)`: Cloudflare R2. Pass the binding name (resolved from `ctx.env` per request) or the bucket object. Multipart uploads use R2's native API.
- `s3Store(options)`: AWS S3, R2's S3 API, MinIO, Backblaze B2. Requests are signed with SigV4 over WebCrypto, so it runs everywhere. Each setting is a literal or `{ env: "NAME" }`, and falls back to `S3_*` / `AWS_*` env vars.

## Signed URLs

`signedUrl` returns `{origin}{basePath}/{token}`, an HMAC-signed bearer URL for one method on one key.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { route } from "miujs";
import "@miujs/files";

export const avatarUpload = route.post("/me/avatar-url", {
  handler: async (ctx) => ({
    // The client PUTs the bytes to this URL with content-type image/png, up to 2 MB.
    put: await ctx.files.signedUrl("avatars/u1.png", { method: "PUT", contentType: "image/png", maxSize: 2 * 1024 * 1024, expiresIn: 600 }),
    // Download as an attachment named avatar.png.
    get: await ctx.files.signedUrl("avatars/u1.png", { download: "avatar.png" }),
  }),
});
```

Downloads support `Range`, `If-None-Match` and `HEAD`. Content types that could run script in the browser are served as attachments with a sandboxing CSP. The secret comes from `files({ secret })`, then `env.FILES_SECRET`, then `env.SESSION_SECRET`; it must be 32+ characters. An array of secrets rotates keys (the first signs, all verify).

## Uploads

`handleUpload` reads `multipart/form-data` or a raw body, detects each file's type from its bytes (`png`, `jpeg`, `webp`, `gif`, `pdf`, `glb`, `mp4`, `zip`), enforces sizes and stores the files. If any file is rejected, none are kept. Use it on routes without a `body` schema.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { route } from "miujs";
import "@miujs/files";

export const upload = route.post("/photos", {
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    const saved = await ctx.files.handleUpload(ctx, { maxSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024, allowedTypes: ["png", "jpeg", "webp"], maxFiles: 3, prefix: "photos/" });
    return { files: saved.map((f) => ({ key: f.key, type: f.contentType, name: f.filename })) };
  },
});
```

### Resumable multipart uploads

For large files the plugin serves these routes under `{basePath}/uploads` (signed-in users only; turn them off with `multipart: false`):

| Route | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /_files/uploads` | Start an upload: body `{ filename?, contentType? }`, returns `{ uploadId, key, expiresAt, maxPartSize, maxSize }`. |
| `PUT /_files/uploads/:id/parts/:n` | Upload part `n` (raw bytes); returns its `etag`. |
| `POST /_files/uploads/:id/complete` | Finish: body `{ parts: [{ partNumber, etag }] }`; returns `{ key, size, etag, contentType }`. |
| `DELETE /_files/uploads/:id` | Abort. |

R2 needs every part except the last to be at least 5 MiB and the same size.

## Options

`files(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `store` | `FileStore` | `memoryStore()` in development; required in production | Where files live. |
| `secret` | `string \| string[]` | `env.FILES_SECRET`, then `env.SESSION_SECRET` | HMAC secret for signed URLs, 32+ characters. |
| `basePath` | `string` | `"/_files"` | Where signed URLs and uploads are served. |
| `publicUrl` | `string` | the request's origin | Origin used in signed URLs. |
| `maxUploadSize` | `number` | `104857600` (100 MiB) | Limit for signed PUT uploads without `maxSize`. |
| `multipart` | `false \| MultipartOptions` | enabled | Resumable upload routes. |
| `onWarning` | `(message) => void` | request logger | Where dev-mode warnings go. |

`multipart` options: `maxSize` (default 5 GiB), `maxPartSize` (default 50 MiB), `allowedTypes`, `expiresIn` (default `86400` s, max 7 days), `key(ctx, file)`.

`signedUrl(key, options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expiresIn` | `number` | `900` | Seconds until the URL stops working (max 7 days). |
| `method` | `"GET" \| "PUT"` | `"GET"` | Download or upload. |
| `contentType` | `string` | none | PUT only: required content type. |
| `maxSize` | `number` | plugin `maxUploadSize` | PUT only: max bytes. |
| `download` | `string` | none | GET only: serve as an attachment with this name. |

`handleUpload(ctx, options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxSize` | `number` | required | Max bytes per file. |
| `allowedTypes` | `string[]` | required | Accepted types, checked against the bytes. |
| `field` | `string` | `"file"` | Form field holding the file(s). |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | `1` | Most files per request. |
| `prefix` | `string` | `"uploads/"` | Prefix of generated keys. |
| `key` | `(file) => string` | `<prefix><random><ext>` | Choose the key yourself. |
| `metadata` | `Record<string, string>` | none | Extra metadata stored with each file. |

## Errors

- `MIU_E_FILES_KEY_INVALID`: the key is not a safe relative path (400).
- `MIU_E_FILES_NOT_FOUND`: no file under this key (404).
- `MIU_E_FILES_TOO_LARGE`: the file is over `maxSize` (413).
- `MIU_E_FILES_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED`: the detected type is not in `allowedTypes` (415).
- `MIU_E_FILES_TOKEN_INVALID` / `MIU_E_FILES_TOKEN_EXPIRED`: the signed URL was altered, used with the wrong method, or expired (403).
- `MIU_E_FILES_SECRET_MISSING` / `MIU_E_FILES_SECRET_WEAK`: no signing secret in production, or one shorter than 32 characters.
- `MIU_E_FILES_STORE_MISSING`: no `store` configured in production.
- `MIU_E_FILES_RUNTIME`: `localStore` used outside Bun or Node.
- `MIU_E_FILES_BINDING`: the R2 binding is missing from `env`.
- `MIU_E_FILES_UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND` / `MIU_E_FILES_PART_INVALID`: unknown multipart upload, or a bad part.
- `MIU_E_FILES_CONFIG`: invalid options (bad range, metadata over 2 KB, wrong `signedUrl` options).

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md), e.g. [`MIU_E_FILES_NOT_FOUND`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_files_not_found).

## Cloudflare Workers

Use `r2Store("FILES")` with an R2 bucket binding, or `s3Store()` with credentials in `wrangler secret`. Set `FILES_SECRET` with `wrangler secret put FILES_SECRET`. With `r2Store("<name>")`, `miu deploy cloudflare` declares the bucket:

```toml
[[r2_buckets]]
binding = "FILES"
bucket_name = "files"
```

`localStore` is Bun/Node only. `memoryStore` works on Workers but is per isolate, so use it only in development.

# @miujs/web

> Server-rendered web pages for MiuJS: escaped `html` templates and JSX without a build, static files, htmx helpers, Vite assets and security headers.

`@miujs/web` turns a MiuJS app into a website. `html` tagged templates and the JSX runtime render straight to escaped HTML strings (no virtual DOM), `render()` wraps them in a `text/html` Response, and plugins serve static files, Vite builds and baseline security headers. Use it for server-rendered pages, htmx apps, or to serve a single-page app next to your API.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/web miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { html, render, secureHeaders, staticFiles } from "@miujs/web";

const Layout = (title: string, body: unknown) => html`<!doctype html>
<html><head><title>${title}</title><link rel="stylesheet" href="/app.css"></head>
<body>${body}</body></html>`;

export const hello = route.get("/hello/:name", {
  params: t.object({ name: t.string() }),
  handler: ({ params }) => render(Layout("Hello", html`<h1>Hello ${params.name}</h1>`)),
});

const app = miu({
  routes: [hello],
  plugins: [staticFiles({ dir: "public" }), secureHeaders()],
});
export default app;

const res = await app.request("/hello/%3Cb%3E");
console.log(await res.text()); // <h1>Hello &lt;b&gt;</h1>, inside the layout
```

Interpolated strings are escaped. Nested `html` results, JSX and `raw(trusted)` are inserted as-is. Arrays are flattened; `null`, `undefined` and booleans render nothing. A Promise or a function in a template throws (`MIU_E_WEB_HTML_ASYNC`, `MIU_E_WEB_HTML_FUNCTION`): await data first, call components.

## JSX

Set `"jsx": "react-jsx", "jsxImportSource": "@miujs/web"` in tsconfig.json, or put `/** @jsxImportSource @miujs/web */` at the top of a `.tsx` file. Elements are `HtmlString`s, so they mix freely with `html` and `render()`.

<!-- test -->
```tsx
/** @jsxImportSource @miujs/web */
import { route } from "miujs";
import { render } from "@miujs/web";

const Item = (props: { name: string }) => <li class="item">{props.name}</li>;

export const list = route.get("/list", {
  handler: () => render(<ul>{["a", "<b>"].map((name) => <Item name={name} />)}</ul>),
});
```

`className` becomes `class`, `htmlFor` becomes `for`, `style` accepts an object. Inline event handlers (`onClick`) are rejected (`MIU_E_WEB_JSX_EVENT_HANDLER`); use a nonce'd script or htmx attributes. `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html }}` is supported for trusted strings.

## htmx

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { route, t } from "miujs";
import { html, hxRedirect, hxTrigger, isHtmx, render, renderPage } from "@miujs/web";

const layout = (body: unknown) => html`<html><body><main>${body}</main></body></html>`;

export const page = route.get("/todos", {
  // htmx requests get the partial; full page loads (and hx-boost) get the layout too.
  handler: (ctx) => renderPage(ctx, html`<ul id="todos"><li>Milk</li></ul>`, layout),
});

export const add = route.post("/todos", {
  body: t.object({ title: t.string({ minLength: 1 }) }),
  handler: ({ body, headers }) => {
    const row = render(html`<li>${body.title}</li>`, { status: 201 });
    return headers.get("hx-request") === "true" ? hxTrigger("todo:added", { title: body.title }, row) : row;
  },
});

export const done = route.post("/done", {
  handler: (ctx) => (isHtmx(ctx) ? hxRedirect("/todos") : new Response(null, { status: 303, headers: { location: "/todos" } })),
});
```

`renderPage` sets `Vary: HX-Request`. `hxRedirect` accepts only paths and http(s) URLs. `hxTrigger(event, detail?, response?)` returns an empty 204 when no response is given.

## Static files

`staticFiles({ dir })` serves a folder for GET/HEAD requests no route matched, with ETag and Last-Modified (304s), single byte ranges, precompressed `.br`/`.gz` siblings, directory `index.html`, and `Cache-Control: immutable` for hashed file names. `..`, backslashes, `:` and NUL bytes are refused with `MIU_E_WEB_BAD_PATH`; dotfiles other than `.well-known` are not served. Use `spa: "index.html"` for client-side routing. `createStaticHandler(opts)` is the same handler for plugins of your own.

## Security headers and CSP nonces

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { html, nonce, render, secureHeaders } from "@miujs/web";

export const home = route.get("/", {
  handler: (ctx) => render(html`<script nonce="${nonce(ctx)}">console.log("ok")</script>`),
});

export default miu({
  routes: [home],
  plugins: [secureHeaders({ csp: true, frameAncestors: ["'self'"], hsts: { maxAge: 63072000, preload: true } })],
});
```

Every response gets `X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `X-Frame-Options` plus CSP `frame-ancestors`, `Permissions-Policy`, and HSTS over https. With `csp`, a per-request nonce is added to `script-src` (and to `style-src` unless it allows `'unsafe-inline'`). Headers a handler already set are left alone.

## Vite

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { html, render, vite } from "@miujs/web";

const assets = vite({ dev: "http://localhost:5173", spa: "index.html" });

export const index = route.get("/", {
  handler: () => render(html`<!doctype html><head>${assets.assetTags("src/main.ts")}</head><body><div id="app"></div></body>`),
});

export default miu({ routes: [index], plugins: [assets] });
```

In dev mode (`app.dev` and a `dev` URL) unmatched GETs are proxied to the Vite dev server and `assetTags` points at it. In production `dist` is served with the static handler and `assetTags(entry, { nonce })` emits stylesheet, module script and modulepreload tags from the build manifest.

## Options

`staticFiles(options)` / `createStaticHandler(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dir` | `string` | required | Folder to serve, relative to the working directory. |
| `prefix` | `string` | `"/"` | URL path the folder is mounted at. |
| `spa` | `string` | none | File served for unknown paths when the request accepts HTML. |
| `index` | `string` | `"index.html"` | File served for directory requests. |
| `immutable` | `RegExp` | `DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE` (`/-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\./`) | Names that get a one-year immutable `Cache-Control`. |
| `precompressed` | `boolean` | `true` | Serve `.br` / `.gz` siblings when accepted. |
| `source` | `FileSource` | `bunFileSource()` on Bun, `nodeFileSource()` elsewhere | Where files are read from. |

`secureHeaders(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frameAncestors` | `string[]` | `["'none'"]` | CSP `frame-ancestors`; `'none'` sends `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `'self'` sends `SAMEORIGIN`. |
| `csp` | `boolean \| CspDirectives` | off | `true` uses `DEFAULT_CSP`; an object lists directives (camelCase or kebab-case). Adds a nonce. |
| `hsts` | `false \| { maxAge?, includeSubDomains?, preload? }` | `{ maxAge: 31536000, includeSubDomains: true }` | Sent only over https (or `x-forwarded-proto: https`). |
| `permissionsPolicy` | `false \| Record<string, string[]>` | `DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS_POLICY` | Merged over the defaults (camera, microphone, geolocation, ... disabled). |
| `referrerPolicy` | `string` | `"strict-origin-when-cross-origin"` | `Referrer-Policy` value. |

`vite(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dev` | `string` | none | Vite dev server URL; used only when the app is in dev mode. |
| `dist` | `string` | `"dist"` | Build output folder. |
| `manifest` | `string \| ViteManifest` | `".vite/manifest.json"` | Manifest path inside `dist`, or the manifest object (required on Workers). |
| `base` | `string` | `"/"` | Vite's `base`. |
| `spa` | `string` | none | SPA fallback file inside `dist`. |

`render(body, { status, headers })` defaults to status 200 and `text/html; charset=utf-8`.

## Errors

- `MIU_E_WEB_HTML_ASYNC`, `MIU_E_WEB_HTML_FUNCTION`: a Promise or function was interpolated ([docs](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_web_html_async)).
- `MIU_E_WEB_HTML_RAW`: `raw()` got a non-string.
- `MIU_E_WEB_JSX_TAG`, `MIU_E_WEB_JSX_ATTR`, `MIU_E_WEB_JSX_EVENT_HANDLER`, `MIU_E_WEB_JSX_VOID_CHILDREN`, `MIU_E_WEB_JSX_INNER_HTML`: invalid JSX.
- `MIU_E_WEB_BAD_PATH`: a static path tried to leave the folder (400).
- `MIU_E_WEB_NO_NONCE`: `nonce(ctx)` without `secureHeaders({ csp })`.
- `MIU_E_WEB_HX_URL`: `hxRedirect` to a non-http(s) URL.
- `MIU_E_WEB_VITE_MANIFEST`, `MIU_E_WEB_VITE_ENTRY`, `MIU_E_WEB_VITE_DEV_UNREACHABLE`: Vite manifest or dev server problems.
- `MIU_E_WEB_CONFIG`: invalid plugin options.

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md).

## Cloudflare Workers

`html`, JSX, `render`, htmx helpers and `secureHeaders` work unchanged. On Workers, `staticFiles()` (and `vite()` in production) does not read the file system: it forwards unmatched GET/HEAD requests to the `ASSETS` binding (Workers Static Assets) and falls through when it returns 404 or is not bound. Configure `[assets]` in `wrangler.toml` yourself; these plugins do not declare it through `cloudflare()`. `vite()` cannot read the manifest file on Workers, so pass the manifest object: `vite({ manifest })`. `bunFileSource()` and `nodeFileSource()` are for Bun, Node and Deno only.

- [Error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md)

<!-- source: packages/mail/README.md -->

# @miujs/mail

> Transactional email for MiuJS: `ctx.mail.send()`, templates, Resend and generic HTTP transports, and a dev outbox preview at `/_miu/mail`.

`@miujs/mail` adds `ctx.mail` to every request and validates every message before it reaches a transport: addresses, header injection, and that there is a subject and a body. In development, with no transport, mail is logged and shown at `/_miu/mail`; in production a transport is required. Use `createMailer()` to send from jobs, workflows and scripts outside requests.

## Install

```bash
bun add @miujs/mail miujs
```

Bun runs the TypeScript source; Node and Deno get prebuilt JS with `.d.ts` types (npm packages are not published yet).

## Quick start

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route, t } from "miujs";
import { mail, resendTransport } from "@miujs/mail";

export const invite = route.post("/invites", {
  body: t.object({ email: t.string() }),
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    const { id } = await ctx.mail.send({ to: ctx.body.email, subject: "You are invited", html: "<p>Come join us.</p>" });
    return { id };
  },
});

export default miu({
  name: "app",
  routes: [invite],
  // resendTransport() reads RESEND_API_KEY from the env (a secret on Workers).
  plugins: [mail({ transport: resendTransport(), from: "Acme <noreply@acme.com>" })],
});
```

`send()` returns `{ id }`: the provider's message id when it returns one, otherwise a generated id. When only `html` is given, a plain-text version is derived with `htmlToText`.

## Messages

A message has `to` (one address or an array), `subject`, `html` and/or `text`, optional `replyTo` and extra `headers` (for example `List-Unsubscribe`). Addresses may be `ann@example.com` or `Ann <ann@example.com>`. Headers that name senders or recipients (`from`, `to`, `cc`, `bcc`, `reply-to`, ...) cannot be set through `headers`, and CR/LF in the subject or header values is refused.

## Templates

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { createMailer, defineTemplate, escapeHtml, memoryTransport } from "@miujs/mail";

const welcome = defineTemplate("welcome", (data: { name: string }) => ({
  subject: `Welcome, ${data.name}`,
  html: `<p>Hello ${escapeHtml(data.name)}</p>`,
}));

const transport = memoryTransport();
const mailer = createMailer({ transport, from: "App <noreply@example.com>", templates: [welcome] });

await mailer.send({ to: "a@example.com", template: "welcome", data: { name: "<Ann>" } });
console.log(transport.outbox[0].subject, transport.outbox[0].text);
```

Fields set on the message (`subject`, `html`, `text`) override the template's output. Escape data you put into `html` with `escapeHtml`. `templates` may be an array or an object of templates.

## Transports

- `resendTransport({ apiKey, apiKeyEnv, baseUrl, fetch })`: Resend over HTTP. Works on every runtime, including Workers.
- `httpTransport({ url, headers, map, id, fetch })`: any provider with a JSON HTTP API (Postmark, SendGrid, Mailgun, an internal relay).
- `consoleTransport({ log, keep })`: logs each message and keeps the last few for `/_miu/mail`. The dev default; never delivers.
- `memoryTransport()`: keeps every message in `.outbox`, with `clear()` and `waitFor(count, timeoutMs)`. For tests.

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { createMailer, httpTransport, type OutgoingMail } from "@miujs/mail";

const transport = httpTransport({
  url: "https://mail.example/send",
  headers: (env) => ({ "x-api-key": String(env.MAIL_KEY) }),
  map: (m: OutgoingMail) => ({ sender: m.from, recipients: m.to, title: m.subject, body: m.text, html: m.html }),
  id: (json) => (json as { messageId?: string } | null)?.messageId,
});

export const mailer = createMailer({ from: "App <noreply@example.com>", env: { MAIL_KEY: "k" }, transport });
```

A custom transport is an object with `kind` and `send(message, env)`; `send` may return `{ id }`. Errors that are not `MiuError`s become `MIU_E_MAIL_SEND_FAILED`.

## Testing

<!-- test -->
```ts
import { miu, route } from "miujs";
import { mail, memoryTransport } from "@miujs/mail";

const transport = memoryTransport();
const app = miu({
  logLevel: "silent",
  plugins: [mail({ transport, from: "App <noreply@example.com>" })],
  routes: [route.post("/invite", { handler: (ctx) => ctx.mail.send({ to: "guest@example.com", subject: "Invite", html: "<p>Come</p>" }) })],
});

await app.fetch(new Request("http://localhost/invite", { method: "POST" }));
const [sent] = await transport.waitFor(1);
console.log(sent.to, sent.subject);
```

## Options

`mail(options)` and `createMailer(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | `string` | required | Sender, e.g. `"Acme <noreply@acme.com>"`. |
| `transport` | `MailTransport` | `consoleTransport()` in dev; required in production | Where mail goes. |
| `templates` | `MailTemplate[] \| Record<string, MailTemplate>` | none | Named templates for `send({ template })`. |
| `env` | `Env` | process env (`createMailer` only; the plugin uses the request env) | Env vars / bindings given to the transport. |
| `dev` | `boolean` | on unless `MIU_ENV`/`NODE_ENV` is `production` or on Workers (`createMailer` only) | Allow the console fallback. |

`resendTransport(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | `string` | `env[apiKeyEnv]` | Resend API key. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `string` | `"RESEND_API_KEY"` | Env var / secret holding the key. |
| `baseUrl` | `string` | `"https://api.resend.com"` | API base URL. |
| `fetch` | `typeof fetch` | global `fetch` | Injectable for tests. |

`httpTransport(options)`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | required | Endpoint that receives a JSON `POST`. |
| `map` | `(message) => unknown` | required | Turns the message into the provider's JSON body. |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string> \| (env) => Record<string, string>` | none | Static headers, or a function of env for API keys. |
| `id` | `(json) => string \| undefined` | none | Picks the provider's message id from the response. |
| `fetch` | `typeof fetch` | global `fetch` | Injectable for tests. |

`consoleTransport(options)`: `log` (default `console.log`), `keep` (default `50`).

## Errors

- `MIU_E_MAIL_TRANSPORT_MISSING`: no transport in production; fails at startup.
- `MIU_E_MAIL_ADDRESS_INVALID`: bad `from`, `to` or `replyTo`, or no recipients (400).
- `MIU_E_MAIL_HEADER_INVALID`: line break in the subject or a header, a reserved header, or a bad header name (400).
- `MIU_E_MAIL_CONTENT_MISSING`: no subject, or neither `html` nor `text`.
- `MIU_E_MAIL_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN`: `template` names a template that was not registered.
- `MIU_E_MAIL_API_KEY_MISSING`: `resendTransport` found no API key.
- `MIU_E_MAIL_SEND_FAILED`: the provider rejected the message or the transport threw (502).

See [all error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md), e.g. [`MIU_E_MAIL_SEND_FAILED`](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md#miu_e_mail_send_failed).

## Cloudflare Workers

No bindings are needed. `resendTransport` and `httpTransport` use `fetch` and read keys from the request env, so store them as secrets:

```bash
wrangler secret put RESEND_API_KEY
```

`createMailer()` never falls back to the console transport on Workers, so pass a transport there. The `mail()` plugin falls back only when the app runs in dev mode, and only then adds the `/_miu/mail` outbox routes.

## Links

- [Getting started guide](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/guide.md)
- [Error codes](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/docs/errors.md)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/AGENTS.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/mail/src)
- [Tests](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/mail/test)
- Related: [@miujs/workflows](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/workflows/README.md), [@miujs/files](https://github.com/khangkhangg/miujs/blob/miujs-monorepo/packages/files/README.md)
